title: Quantum-like randomness comes from incomplete information

statements.text: In the quantum-like model, quantum randomness is not irreducible randomness but a consequence of obtaining incomplete information about a system, in the spirit of Einstein's reading of the wave function.

sources.quote: In our model quantum randomness appears not as irreducible randomness (as it is commonly accepted in conventional quantum mechanics, e.g., by von Neumann and Dirac), but as a consequence of obtaining incomplete information about a system
